**sdd/issue-253-b1/design**

**What**: Technical design for B1 (issue-253-b1) — wire the 6 measured layout sites onto sdd-layout.mjs, add drift-guard A3, fix the new-change slug, and prep the co-promotion branch. Written to openspec/changes/issue-253-b1/design.md.

**Why**: B0 shipped the accessor deliberately unconsumed; B1 is the pure wiring. Design must decide per-site wiring, the golden-capture harness (F1), A3 import-shape precision (F2), the slug mandate, and the co-promo branch (F3), honoring #595 pins + #584 inventory.

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-253-b1/design.md. Sites: check-refs.mjs:96-112, session-start.mjs:38-69, vcs/phase-order-check.mjs (CHANGE_DIR_PREFIX L20 + BASELINE_EXEMPT_DIRS L185), new-change.mjs:48-125, memory/backends/engram.mjs:804-805 & 925-926, memory/lib/feature-resolution.mjs:37-81. Accessor: brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.mjs.

**Learned**:
- Per-site helper map: (1) check-refs -> CHANGES_ROOT + missingRequiredArtifacts + isGrandfathered; (2) session-start -> CHANGES_ROOT + parseChangeId (branch->iid regex STAYS; dir match becomes parseChangeId(name).iid===iid, proven equivalent); (3) phase-order-check -> CHANGES_ROOT + LEGACY_GRANDFATHERED (applyBaselineExemption default arg); (4) new-change -> changeDir + artifactPaths + slug fix; (5) engram (2 sites) -> changeDir + OPERATIONAL_ARTIFACTS[0]; (6) feature-resolution -> CHANGES_ROOT + OPERATIONAL_ARTIFACTS[0].
- Three distinct import depths: ./lib/ (check-refs,session-start,new-change), ../lib/ (phase-order-check), ../../lib/ (engram,feature-resolution). A3 MUST use a per-site specifier map (a shared ../lib/ literal false-negatives 5 of 6). A3 pattern: /import\s*\{[^}]*\}\s*from\s*['\"]<escaped>['\"]/ anchored on the exact specifier ending /sdd-layout.mjs (NOT .test.mjs, NOT loose substring, NOT side-effect import).
- BEHAVIOR-PRESERVATION verified against real tree: all 16 non-grandfathered frozen dirs have all 4 flat artifacts -> missingRequiredArtifacts=[]. The 9 grandfathered-beyond-3 all have nested specs/*/spec.md -> hasSpec=true -> never a downgradeable fail, so exempt-list 3->12 is a corpus no-op. check-refs 2->4 artifact check is latent-stricter for future dirs (closes #584 gap #1); in-scope because golden frozen-set scopes new dirs out.
- Golden harness (F1): test-only (budget-free) = sdd-layout-golden.fixture.json + sdd-layout-golden.test.mjs. Iterates Object.keys(fixture.changes) (the frozen 27), builds a FAKE fs from each key's recorded facts, NEVER live readdir. Header: 'point-in-time migration proof over the frozen 27; new dirs out of scope by design'. Schema stores per key: facts(inputs) + checkRefs.missing + phaseOrder{level,findings} + featureResolution.hasResume; sessionStart in sibling block keyed by branch token. Asserts issue-253-b1 NOT in fixture. RED->GREEN: capture BEFORE from pre-wiring tree (green baseline) -> wire -> regen deepEqual.
- Slug fix: ERROR when --title absent (symmetric with existing --issue fail). spec.md emission already shipped #251 (new-change.mjs:123). Not covered by golden (scaffolder) -> own unit test.
- Co-promo (F3): 2nd branch off feature/v2.0.0, pushed-not-opened. ADR-0019 verified: promoted max=0017, claimed brain-drafts=0018(issue-231-a2) -> 0019 correct. Move adr-draft-harness-port.md -> brain/project/decisions/adr-0019-harness-port.md (Status:Accepted+banner+ISO). Move sdd-layout.md -> brain/core/methodology/. Nav entries in brain/HOME.md + brain/core/templates/HOME.template.md ATOMIC with move (brain:nav fails otherwise). Agent never opens/merges (CP-B0 doctrine).
- Budget: ~43 counted source lines, no size:exception. Tests+fixture+A3+tripwire = budget-free.
- OPEN for tasks: frozen-count reconciliation (pin says 27, HEAD shows 28 non-b1); confirm slug=error vs derive; capture-harness location (test vs shared module); tripwire EXEMPT_PATH_RE consolidation include/defer; 'archive' literal stays inline (residual); co-promo branch name/base SHA at apply.
